info.title: SIPEG UTP API
info.description: Backend REST API for SIPEG UTP: users, event programs, activities, attendance, certificates, classrooms, speakers and reports.

post.summary: Log in with email and password

200.description: Authenticated. Returns an access/refresh token pair.

201.description: Registration successful. An email verification is sent.

post.summary: Log out and revoke the refresh token

200.description: Reset link sent if the email is registered.

post.summary: Reset a password with a token

get.description: Public. Returns SCHEDULED and ONGOING activities of ACTIVE programs with date greater than or equal to today in the institutional time zone America/Panama.

post.description: Creates an activity in DRAFT status inside an ACTIVE event program. Accepts inline speakers; a speaker is reused when the email matches an existing catalog entry and linked to a platform user when the email matches an account. Speakers do not need a platform account. Requires the activity:create permission on the target program (or the ADMIN role).

get.description: Public. Returns ACTIVE event programs ordered by name. Supports filters by organizational unit, unit type and a name/label search term.

200.description: Paginated list of active event programs.

post.description: Creates a non-default event program in DRAFT status for an active organizational unit. Requires the program:create permission; without a scope, only ADMIN users are authorized.

patch.description: Partially updates name, description, label, bannerUrl, startDate and endDate of a specific event program. Requires the program:update permission on the program scope, or the ADMIN role. Archived programs cannot be modified.

200.description: Current health status of the API.

ActivitySpeakerInput.description: Inline speaker data accepted when creating an activity.

accessTokenExpiresAt.description: ISO 8601 expiration timestamp of the access token.

refreshToken.description: Opaque refresh token backed by a server-side session.

refreshTokenExpiresAt.description: ISO 8601 expiration timestamp of the refresh token.

AuthTokens.description: Access and refresh token pair returned by the login and refresh flows.
